Run set -e
  set -e
  APP="skillos"
  RG="skillos-eus2-rg"
  ACR_NAME="***"
  
  ACR_ID=$(az acr show --name "$ACR_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --query id --output tsv)
  
  PRINCIPAL_ID=""
  for i in $(seq 1 6); do
    PRINCIPAL_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "$APP" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.principalId" --output tsv 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$PRINCIPAL_ID" ] && [ "$PRINCIPAL_ID" != "None" ]; then break; fi
    echo "Waiting for managed identity to propagate ($APP, attempt $i/6)..."
    sleep 10
  done
  
  if [ -z "$PRINCIPAL_ID" ] || [ "$PRINCIPAL_ID" = "None" ]; then
    echo "::warning::Could not retrieve managed identity for $APP - AcrPull may be missing. Deploy will likely fail to provision."
  else
    EXISTING=$(az role assignment list --assignee "$PRINCIPAL_ID" --role AcrPull --scope "$ACR_ID" --query "[0].id" --output tsv 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -z "$EXISTING" ]; then
      echo "Granting AcrPull to $APP's managed identity..."
      az role assignment create --assignee "$PRINCIPAL_ID" --role AcrPull --scope "$ACR_ID" --output none
    else
      echo "AcrPull already granted to $APP's managed identity."
    fi
  
    REGISTRY_SET=$(az containerapp registry list --name "$APP" --resource-group "$RG" --query "[?server=='***'].server" --output tsv 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -z "$REGISTRY_SET" ]; then
      echo "Attaching registry via system identity..."
      az containerapp registry set --name "$APP" --resource-group "$RG" --server "***" --identity system --output none
    fi
  fi
  shell: /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail {0}
  env:
    RESOURCE_GROUP: skillos-eus2-rg
    CONTAINER_APP_NAME: skillos
    IMAGE_NAME: skillos

Run FQDN=$(az containerapp show \

1m 36s
Run FQDN="skillos.kindcoast-ec5fb3ce.eastus2.azurecontainerapps.io"
  FQDN="skillos.kindcoast-ec5fb3ce.eastus2.azurecontainerapps.io"
  if [ -z "$FQDN" ]; then
    echo "::warning::No FQDN captured — skipping health check."
    echo "healthy=unknown" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    exit 0
  fi
  # 2026-09-21 fix: this used to be --max-time 15, but app/api/status's
  # own GET handler runs a real AI-provider completion call with a
  # deliberate 45s timeout (see that route's checkAI() comment — needed
  # for slower reasoning-tier models) alongside the DB/Stripe/migration/
  # endpoint checks, all in a single Promise.all — so the route's own
  # worst-case response time can legitimately exceed 45s even when
  # everything is genuinely healthy. A 15s curl timeout was shorter than
  # the route's own slowest real check, so curl silently timed out and
  # returned nothing on EVERY deploy regardless of app health, which
  # `grep -q '"overall":"operational"'` then correctly (but
  # misleadingly) read as "not operational" — triggering the automatic
  # rollback below on every single deploy, forever, with no code change
  # required to cause it. 75s gives the route's own 45s worst case a
  # real margin instead of racing it.
  for i in $(seq 1 6); do
    BODY=$(curl -fsS --max-time 75 "https://$FQDN/api/status" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if echo "$BODY" | grep -q '"overall":"operational"'; then
      echo "Health check passed (attempt $i/6)."
      echo "healthy=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "Health check attempt $i/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s..."
    sleep 15
  done
  echo "::warning::Post-deploy health check did not report operational after 6 attempts."
  echo "healthy=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  shell: /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail {0}
  env:
    RESOURCE_GROUP: skillos-eus2-rg
    CONTAINER_APP_NAME: skillos
    IMAGE_NAME: skillos
Health check attempt 1/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Health check attempt 2/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Health check attempt 3/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Health check attempt 4/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Health check attempt 5/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Health check attempt 6/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s...
Warning: Post-deploy health check did not report operational after 6 attempts.
